First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:15 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
The easiest pace the host lists is 18–20 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

First group ride? Start here →

About the Estero Bicycle Cafe Sunday Ride group ride

Estero Bicycle Cafe Sunday Ride is a road group ride in Estero, FL. It rolls every Sunday at 7:15 am from Estero Bicycle Cafe, Estero Ridge Plaza.

A fast Sunday ride from Estero Bicycle Cafe: out over the Estero Pkwy bridge to Ben Hill Griffin, north through the airport to Treeline Ave and back. All three groups follow the same route. Caloosa Riders list it on their calendar.
